question: List each floor key and department name within the Stata building, as well as the number of rooms, total area, and average area per department on each floor. Include subtotals for each floor and a grand total across all floors. Sort the results by floor key and department name in ascending order. Exclude departments without any rooms in the building. Only the first row of each floor group should include the floor key, and the subtotal and grand total rows should not include floor key or department name. Number of rooms and area should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "rooms_by_org_in_stata" AS WITH stata_bldg AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fclt_building_key AS building_key
    FROM beaver.fclt_building
    WHERE building_name_long ILIKE '%Stata%'
), rooms AS (
    SELECT 
        fr.building_key,
        fr.floor_key,
        fr.organization_name,
        fr.area
    FROM beaver.fac_rooms fr
    JOIN stata_bldg sb ON fr.building_key = sb.building_key
    WHERE fr.organization_name IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(fr.organization_name) <> ''
      AND fr.area IS NOT NULL
      AND fr.area > 0
)
SELECT building_key, floor_key, organization_name, area
FROM rooms
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE rooms_by_org_in_stata AS
WITH stata_bldg AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fclt_building_key AS building_key
    FROM beaver.fclt_building
    WHERE building_name_long ILIKE '%Stata%'
)
SELECT 
    CAST(fr.building_key AS VARCHAR)      AS building_key,
    CAST(fr.floor_key AS VARCHAR)         AS floor_key,
    CAST(fr.organization_name AS VARCHAR) AS organization_name,
    CAST(fr.area AS DOUBLE)               AS area
FROM beaver.fac_rooms fr
JOIN stata_bldg sb ON fr.building_key = sb.building_key
WHERE fr.organization_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(fr.organization_name) <> ''
  AND fr.area IS NOT NULL
  AND fr.area > 0
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "rooms_by_org_in_stata" AS WITH stata_bldg AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fclt_building_key AS building_key
    FROM beaver.fclt_building
    WHERE building_name_long ILIKE '%Stata%'
)
SELECT 
    fr.building_key AS building_key,
    fr.floor_key AS floor_key,
    fr.organization_name AS organization_name,
    fr.area AS area
FROM beaver.fac_rooms fr
JOIN stata_bldg sb ON fr.building_key = sb.building_key
WHERE fr.organization_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(fr.organization_name) <> ''
  AND fr.area IS NOT NULL
  AND fr.area > 0

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT floor_key, organization_name AS department,
         COUNT(*) AS room_count,
         SUM(area) AS total_area,
         AVG(area) AS avg_area
  FROM rooms_by_org_in_stata
  WHERE organization_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(organization_name) <> ''
  GROUP BY floor_key, organization_name
),
sub AS (
  SELECT floor_key, NULL AS department,
         SUM(room_count) AS room_count,
         SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
         AVG(avg_area) AS avg_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY floor_key
),
grand AS (
  SELECT NULL AS floor_key, NULL AS department,
         SUM(room_count) AS room_count,
         SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
         AVG(avg_area) AS avg_area
  FROM base
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT floor_key, department, room_count, total_area, avg_area, 1 AS ord, department AS dept_sort
  FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT floor_key, department, room_count, total_area, avg_area, 2 AS ord, NULL AS dept_sort FROM sub
  UNION ALL
  SELECT floor_key, department, room_count, total_area, avg_area, 3 AS ord, NULL AS dept_sort FROM grand
),
with_rownum AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY floor_key ORDER BY ord, dept_sort) AS rn
  FROM ordered
),
formatted AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN department IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN rn = 1 THEN floor_key ELSE NULL END AS floor_key,
    CASE WHEN department IS NULL THEN (CASE WHEN ord = 2 THEN 'Subtotal' ELSE 'Grand total' END) ELSE department END AS department,
    -- Round to integers and format with commas
    FORMAT('{:,}', CAST(ROUND(room_count) AS BIGINT)) AS rooms,
    FORMAT('{:,}', CAST(ROUND(total_area) AS BIGINT)) AS total_area,
    FORMAT('{:,}', CAST(ROUND(NULLIF(avg_area, 0)) AS BIGINT)) AS avg_area
  FROM with_rownum
  ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN floor_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    COALESCE(with_rownum.floor_key, ''),
    ord,
    dept_sort
)
SELECT * FROM formatted

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT floor_key,
         organization_name AS department,
         COUNT(*) AS rooms,
         SUM(area) AS total_area,
         AVG(area) AS avg_area
  FROM rooms_by_org_in_stata
  WHERE organization_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(organization_name) <> ''
  GROUP BY floor_key, organization_name
),
-- Details ordered by floor_key asc, department asc
base_ord AS (
  SELECT floor_key, department, rooms, total_area, avg_area,
         1 AS ord, department AS dept_sort
  FROM base
),
-- Subtotals per floor
sub AS (
  SELECT floor_key,
         NULL AS department,
         SUM(rooms) AS rooms,
         SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
         AVG(avg_area) AS avg_area,
         2 AS ord,
         NULL AS dept_sort
  FROM base
  GROUP BY floor_key
),
-- Grand total across all floors
grand AS (
  SELECT NULL AS floor_key,
         NULL AS department,
         SUM(rooms) AS rooms,
         SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
         AVG(avg_area) AS avg_area,
         3 AS ord,
         NULL AS dept_sort
  FROM base
),
unioned AS (
  SELECT * FROM base_ord
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM sub
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand
),
-- Order: floors first (non-null), then by floor_key asc, then details then subtotal, finally grand total at end
ordered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM unioned
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN floor_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
           floor_key NULLS LAST,
           ord,
           dept_sort
),
-- Row numbering to only show floor_key on first row within each floor group (details come before subtotal by ord)
with_rn AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY floor_key ORDER BY ord, dept_sort) AS rn
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN department IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN rn = 1 THEN floor_key ELSE NULL END AS floor_key,
  CASE WHEN department IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN ord = 2 THEN 'Subtotal' ELSE 'Grand total' END ELSE department END AS department,
  FORMAT('{:,}', CAST(ROUND(rooms) AS BIGINT)) AS rooms,
  FORMAT('{:,}', CAST(ROUND(total_area) AS BIGINT)) AS total_area,
  FORMAT('{:,}', CAST(ROUND(NULLIF(avg_area, 0)) AS BIGINT)) AS avg_area
FROM with_rn
ORDER BY CASE WHEN floor_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         floor_key NULLS LAST,
         ord,
         dept_sort

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT floor_key,
         organization_name AS department,
         COUNT(*) AS rooms,
         SUM(area) AS total_area,
         AVG(area) AS avg_area
  FROM rooms_by_org_in_stata
  WHERE organization_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(organization_name) <> ''
  GROUP BY floor_key, organization_name
),
-- detail rows with desired sort key (department asc)
detail AS (
  SELECT floor_key, department, rooms, total_area, avg_area,
         1 AS ord, department AS dept_sort
  FROM base
),
-- per-floor subtotals
sub AS (
  SELECT floor_key,
         NULL AS department,
         SUM(rooms) AS rooms,
         SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
         AVG(avg_area) AS avg_area,
         2 AS ord,
         NULL AS dept_sort
  FROM base
  GROUP BY floor_key
),
-- grand total row
grand AS (
  SELECT NULL AS floor_key,
         NULL AS department,
         SUM(rooms) AS rooms,
         SUM(total_area) AS total_area,
         AVG(avg_area) AS avg_area,
         3 AS ord,
         NULL AS dept_sort
  FROM base
),
-- combine
u AS (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM sub
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand
),
-- order: floors first (by floor_key asc), departments asc, then subtotal, finally grand total
ord AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM u
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN floor_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
           floor_key NULLS LAST,
           ord,
           dept_sort
),
-- row number within each floor to blank floor_key after first detail row; subtotal/grand have NULL department and must blank both
rn AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY floor_key ORDER BY ord, dept_sort) AS r
  FROM ord
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN department IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN r = 1 THEN floor_key ELSE NULL END AS floor_key,
  CASE WHEN department IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN ord = 2 THEN 'Subtotal' ELSE 'Grand total' END ELSE department END AS department,
  FORMAT('{:,}', CAST(ROUND(rooms) AS BIGINT)) AS rooms,
  FORMAT('{:,}', CAST(ROUND(total_area) AS BIGINT)) AS total_area,
  FORMAT('{:,}', CAST(ROUND(NULLIF(avg_area,0)) AS BIGINT)) AS avg_area
FROM rn
ORDER BY CASE WHEN floor_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         floor_key NULLS LAST,
         ord,
         dept_sort
